Title: Configurable Backup Storage Redundancy option for Azure SQL Managed Instance

Body.Content: Now in general availability, locally redundant storage (LRS) and zone-redundant storage (ZRS) options have been added to backup storage redundancy, providing more flexibility and choice. With this announcement, you now have more cost-effective options for ensuring data is protected in case of planned and unplanned events. Easily configure backup storage redundancy in Azure portal. For more information, see our Tech Community blog.
